name: reshade-renodx
description: firehoooo's E_ABORT box: this install as it stands, plus RTSS running, plus the mod pinned to 1.1.1

report.verdict: E_ABORT from sl.interposer.dll on the game's own Present, ~19 s at the title, 3/3 crash. Fixed by 4b97357 (no second swapchain), shipped in 1.3.0.

payloads.note: ReShade 6.8.0.2155 64-bit proxy - the thing that adopts our swapchain as a second runtime
RenoDX DLSS addon; ReShade loads it from DllMain
older RenoDX addon; the .addon64x extension is not scanned, so it is inert
AddonPath=. and LoadFromDllMain=renodx-dlss.addon64 are what make the addon load
leftover second config, read by nothing; declared because it is on the box
OptiScaler's slot - the other firehoooo configuration, not this one

expect.note: the crash arrives at ~19-21 s and the module list is read at ~13 s, so the modules are readable in a cell that then crashes. The crash itself leaves NO line in the mod log - the process dies under a modal box mid-sentence - so the signature is the window title, which the runner records as the cell's `why`. log_lines instead pins the build and the mechanism under test, quoted from the run of 2026-09-20: 1.1.1 writes its log beside the DLL rather than to LOCALAPPDATA, and both locations are read.
log_lines: streamline: NVIDIA frame generation (DLSS-G) is LOADED

manual.rtss: RTSS must be running BEFORE the run starts; this script checks for it and never starts or stops it. THE VERSION DIFFERS FROM THE REPORT: firehoooo had 7.3.7, this box has 7.3.5.28314 (RivaTuner Statistics Server, Program Files x86). Reproducing the crash on 7.3.5 says the bug is not specific to 7.3.7; failing to reproduce it would settle nothing until 7.3.7 has been tried.
manual.driver_vsync: the owner's word — not readable from a script
manual.monitors: three: 1920x1080 @ 75 Hz primary, 1920x1080 @ 100 Hz, 1080x1920 @ 75 Hz rotated; the game runs on the primary
